summary: Independent fresh design review approves the revised frozen specification after exact recomputation and comparison of the native v2 design context. The revision returns to the actual owner request: a thin, opt-in self-managed official SDK client for one fixed-document read-only review using the existing ChatGPT login/subscription, followed by the existing real PR feedback readback. The earlier named root-deny/input-only profile, outside-read OS canary, blanket Windows rejection and consequent Linux/WSL direction were Agent-added hardening, not original owner requirements; removing them corrects scope rather than relaxing the owner requirements or quality gates. The installed SDK 0.163.0 exposes the supported read_only preset and maps it to the readOnly policy. The design must explicitly request and verify read-only, approval never and disabled tool-network access, with unnecessary shell, external search, MCP, plugins and subagents disabled, before the sole model turn. It does not claim an input-directory read whitelist, complete actual model context or strict zero tools; access may not exceed the existing root-read baseline. Normal SDK/runtime state writes and Windows sandbox or ACL maintenance may occur, so absolute side-effect-free startup is not promised. There is no WSL installation, new execution environment, credential migration, manual ACL change, global configuration write, API-key billing or purchase. Fixed Git blobs, explicit application-supplied material, manifest/hash binding, optional pinning, default zero SDK construction, unused ignored output reservation, bounded lifecycle and cancellation handling, preserved failure/unknown receipts, small validated findings and explicit inherited-instruction hashes remain appropriate for the real task. SDK interruption or local timeout must not be promoted to confirmed remote stop, settled cost, authenticated actual model identity or complete context. Existing readers and PR feedback formats are reused without a new provider layer, scheduler, database, Schema or automatic arrangement. Prior review and attempt evidence remain preserved. This design approval does not validate the revised implementation or a real SDK result; meaningful updated regressions, pinned compatibility, full native V1, independent implementation review, Gate and required CI are still required before publication. Goal completion additionally needs a valid real final report and actual feedback readback; real scoring, research sample admission, T0/T1, Desktop attachment and cross-repository initialization remain separate. No open design findings remain.
